messages:
maria.chen: thinking about a quick migration to materialize a small route lookup to avoid the heavy joins in console dashboards. p99 reads are spiking on peak queries
kevin: can you show which query and numbers?
maria.chen: dashboard: telemetry.events JOIN routes JOIN quota_profiles. p95 ~450ms but p99 ~2.3s on the big orgs during release windows
jordan: denorming could help. what's the proposal surface?
maria.chen: create a tiny route_lookup table that consolidates route_id -> route_key, quota_profile_id, route_label. keep it updated from ingest so console reads become a single PK lookup
olivia: how many rows? storage/ops impact?
maria.chen: ~150k active routes, <1M total. small table, fits in PG or can be cached in Redis. expected memory ~50-120MB depending on columns
jordan: ok, what about consistency between ingest and analytics streams?
maria.chen: dualwrite plan: backfill snapshot, enable dualwrite for 48-72h with feature flag, run checksum jobs, then cut reads to route_lookup. rollback by flipping reads back to join if divergence >0.1%
maria.chen: schema snippet: 
```
CREATE TABLE route_lookup_v1 (
  route_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
  route_key text,
  quota_profile_id uuid,
  route_label text,
  updated_at timestamptz
);
```
kevin: who owns backfill and dualwrite? can we run canary on internal org only?
maria.chen: infra team (me + kevin) will own backfill and ingest change. canary: internal orgs first then 10% of traffic
jordan: also add an index on route_key for some UI filters, and consider an LRU cache eviction for Redis backing
maria.chen: plan includes `CREATE INDEX ON route_lookup_v1(route_key);` and TTL sweep for soft deletes
olivia: monitoring? what alerts do we need?
maria.chen: monitor: console-query-latency p95/p99, route_lookup_table_size, checksum_mismatch_rate, analytics_db_cpu, and an ingest error rate. set warning if mismatch > 0.05% for 1h, critical at 0.1%
sre-bot: Scheduled job: route_lookup_backfill started at 2024-05-03T14:12:00Z (job id 27382) :white_check_mark:
kevin: good. PR + feature flag?
maria.chen: PR up: https://git.company/repo/pull/4567 — includes backfill job, dualwrite hooks, checksum job, and playbook
jordan: one operational concern: frequent route updates might cause churn. what's eviction/compaction strategy?
maria.chen: we'll write tombstones and a periodic compaction job to purge soft-deletes older than 30d. hot updates will upsert and update `updated_at`
kevin: rollback path is quick because of dualwrite. if checksum spikes during canary we flip reads to join immediately
olivia: +1 for canary on internal org only first. also add a small dashboard card that shows mismatch rate and backfill progress for SRE/Product
maria.chen: noted. I'll draft the rollout playbook and schedule a two-step deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT: backfill -> dualwrite -> monitor -> read cutover
jordan: please attach EXPLAIN plans pre/post after backfill so we can quantify query savings
maria.chen: will do. thanks all :rocket:
